metaTitle: Jaguar R/SVR Performance Engine Rebuild | Jaguar Garage
metaDescription: Specialist performance engine rebuild for Jaguar R and SVR models – F-Type, F-Pace, XFR, XJR. Full strip-down, machining, supercharger service, and precision assembly.
h1: Jaguar R / SVR Performance Engine Rebuild
lede: Full performance engine rebuild for Jaguar R and SVR models – including supercharger service, precision machining, and assembly to factory specifications.

blocks.html: Jaguar R and SVR models demand a higher level of precision and care during engine rebuilding. Our performance rebuild service combines the full standard rebuild process with extra steps specific to supercharged, high-output engines.

chips.label: **Full strip-down**
chips.desc: the engine is completely disassembled, with every component labelled and inspected.

chips.label: **Machining to factory tolerances**
chips.desc: cylinders are bored and honed, surfaces resurfaced, and all critical dimensions restored to OEM specifications.

chips.label: **Inspection and component selection**
chips.desc: all parts are measured and assessed; worn or out-of-spec items are replaced with genuine Jaguar or equivalent-quality parts.

chips.label: **Precision reassembly**
chips.desc: the engine is rebuilt using factory procedures, with absolute attention to torque settings, clearances, and alignment.

chips.label: **High-load road test**
chips.desc: after installation, the vehicle undergoes a full road test to verify performance under real-world conditions.

chips.label: **Supercharger servicing**
chips.desc: R and SVR models use Eaton TVS superchargers (on AJ126 and AJ133 engines). These are rebuilt as part of the service with new bearings, fresh supercharger oil, new seals, and a replacement coupler.

chips.label: **Absolute precision assembly**
chips.desc: with outputs up to 575 PS in SVR specification, every clearance and torque setting must be exact. We work to Jaguar factory specifications using OEM tools and procedures.

chips.label: **Component quality**
chips.desc: we use OEM or OEM-specification parts. Where appropriate, we may fit upgraded components for enhanced durability under sustained performance driving.

paras: Final cost depends on condition and any additional parts required. We provide a fixed-price quote after full inspection and strip-down. [View pricing disclaimer →](/pricing-legal-disclaimer)

sections.heading: FAQs — R / SVR Performance Engine Rebuild

items.q: What does a Jaguar R/SVR performance engine rebuild involve?
items.a: A full performance rebuild includes complete engine strip-down, inspection, machining to restore OEM tolerances, reassembly with OEM components, and a high-load road test. For supercharged R/SVR engines, we also rebuild the Eaton TVS supercharger – replacing bearings, oil, seals, and coupler.

items.q: Which Jaguar models does this apply to?
items.a: This service covers all Jaguar R and SVR models including F-Type R/SVR, F-Pace SVR, XFR/XFR-S, and XJR – all equipped with the 5.0L supercharged AJ133 V8. We also offer performance rebuilds for the supercharged AJ126 V6 where applicable.

items.q: How long does a performance engine rebuild take?
items.a: Typically 3–5 weeks depending on parts availability and machining requirements. We provide a clear timeline after initial inspection and strip-down.

items.q: Do you use genuine Jaguar parts?
items.a: Yes – we use OEM or OEM-specification parts. In some cases we may recommend upgraded components for enhanced durability under performance driving, and we discuss these options with you beforehand.

items.q: Is the supercharger rebuilt as part of the service?
items.a: Yes – for R and SVR engines, we rebuild the Eaton TVS supercharger with new bearings, fresh oil, new seals, and a replacement coupler as part of a comprehensive performance rebuild.
